        "All four owned diffs read, including both complete new C++ helper/header and build registration. Rust changes from NewChannel to NewURI plus a new_loadinfo_with_cookie_settings call and NewChannelFromURIWithLoadInfo. This is Part1 infrastructure, not complete NTLM negotiation or authentication.",
        "The helper guards the loading principal, uses LoadInfo::Create, computes the fingerprinting flag, creates an eRegular cookie jar, checks SetCookieJarSettings and transfers the result. Its header/comment says user cookie blocking remains respected.
